longDescription: Independent experimental ImageSlide GIF fork by ggazzeta, based on Santiago Pérez (MIT). Windows x64 and macOS x64/arm64 native dependencies are packaged and statically verified; physical GIF support is unverified on all platforms. Native GIF, bounded PNG frames, and poster modes preserve gallery, clock, weather and system panels. Setup is a private profile technique with exact Windows build pins; macOS users reopen Studio manually and the clock overlay can remain visible. No public animated-support claim or store submission is made. Technique attribution: https://github.com/chilleno/claude-deck.
